inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - School Information for School-age Child: There was no school-age information available at the time of the inspection.    NOTE: This was corrected at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Special Needs Statement (26 TAC §746.605(13))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Parent Rights: The operational policy was missing a written statement on the parents' rights.  NOTE: This was corrected at inspection.     The operational policy was missing written statements on the promotion of indoor and outdoor physical activities.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Parent Rights (26 TAC §746.501(a)(20))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training- Required Content: One out of three files evaluated does not have the required training in the following topics:   Preventing and responding to emergencies due to food or an allergic reaction;  and Handling, storing, and disposing of hazardous materials.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: 1 of 4 children's records evaluated did not have current immunization records on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: Several nap mats were torn with foam exposed. Note: This was corrected at inspection when the nap mats were removed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required: 1 of the 4 staff files evaluated did not have current training hours for one caregiver.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1309(a))

occurrences.finding: Director Annual Training - Additional required topics: The Director does not have the required training in the following topics:  Preventing and responding to emergencies due to food or an allergic reaction; and  Handling, storing, and disposing of hazardous materials including compliance with ?746.3425 of this chapter (relating to Must caregivers wear gloves when handling blood or bodily fluids containing blood?)-
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training - Additional required topics (26 TAC §746.1311(e))

occurrences.finding: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child: Caregiver did not wash their hands after diaper changing. This was corrected at inspection when the caregiver was prompted to wash their hands.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child (26 TAC §746.3415(4))

occurrences.finding: Director Annual Training - Caring for children under 24 months: The Director of this operation provides care for children younger than 24 months of age, and does not have the required training. One clock hour of the annual training hours must cover the following topics:  (1) Recognizing and preventing shaken baby syndrome and abusive head trauma;  (2) Understanding and using safe sleep practices and preventing sudden infant death syndrome (SIDS); and  (3) Understanding early childhood brain development.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training - Caring for children under 24 months (26 TAC §746.1311(d))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR: One caregiver has expired Pediatric CPR certification as of 11/04/24.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1315(b))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking.: One caregiver has expired Pediatric First Aid certification as of 11/04/24.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: 3 out of 4 children's records did not have current immunization records on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training - Caregivers of Children Under 24 Months Required: One caregiver that provides care for children younger than 24 months of age, does not have the required training. One clock hour of the annual training hours must cover the following topics:  (1) Recognizing and preventing shaken baby syndrome and abusive head trauma;  (2) Understanding and using safe sleep practices and preventing sudden infant death syndrome (SIDS); and  (3) Understanding early childhood brain development.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training - Caregivers of Children Under 24 Months Required (26 TAC §746.1309(d))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training- Required Content: One caregiver does not have the required training in the following topics:    Preventing and responding to emergencies due to food or an allergic reaction;     and     Handling, storing, and disposing of hazardous materials including compliance with ?746.3425 of this chapter (relating to Must caregivers wear gloves when handling blood or bodily fluids containing blood?)
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))

occurrences.finding: Children's Products- Annual Certification: The children's product form has not been re-certified.  The form was last certified on 3/10/2023.    Note:  Corrected at inspection when director completed the form during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §746.4135(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: Two files reviewed did not include neceassy informaton for their listed emergency contact.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Controlling Person - Submit Controlling Person Form to Licensing within two days after a person becomes a controlling person. See TAC 745.901: A required individual was not added to the operation's controlling person list within the required time frame.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Controlling Person - Submit Controlling Person Form to Licensing within two days after a person becomes a controlling person. See TAC 745.901 (26 TAC §745.903(2))

occurrences.finding: Health Statement parent sign - Dated within past yr, name/address health care professional, states child can participate. Follow by signed statement: One of the four children's files reviewed did not include a signed health statement 12 months after the enrollment date.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Health Statement parent sign - Dated within past yr, name/address health care professional, states child can participate. Follow by signed statement (26 TAC §746.611(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - List entitled "Current Employees"--sized at least 81/2 X 11 inches, printed legibly, include employee first and last name: The posted employee list was not current as it included names no longer associated with the opeation and did not list employees present at the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - List entitled "Current Employees"--sized at least 81/2 X 11 inches, printed legibly, include employee first and last name (26 TAC §746.401(9))

occurrences.finding: Requirement of Gas Leak Inspection: The last gas inspection was conducted 12/13/2021.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirement of Gas Leak Inspection (26 TAC §746.5401)

occurrences.finding: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: One of the four children's files reviewed did not include a current immunization record.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Infant Not in Crib with Drop Gate Down: Upon arrival to the center, there was a drop gate that was not secured in the upward position with a child in the crib.  This was corrected when the drop gate was secured in an upward position.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Infant Not in Crib with Drop Gate Down (26 TAC §746.2409(c))

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering: One child did not wash their hands after a diaper change.  This was corrected when the caregiver washed the child's hands.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering (26 TAC §746.3417(3))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Equipment for Infants - Bean Bags, Waterbeds, Foam Pads As Sleeping Equipment: At the time of inspection a blanket was being used as a crib sheet for a child under 12 months.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Equipment for Infants - Bean Bags, Waterbeds, Foam Pads As Sleeping Equipment (26 TAC §746.2415(a)(5))

occurrences.finding: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child: At the time of inspection the caregiver in the three year old classroom did not wash their hands after a diaper change.  This was corrected when the caregiver washed their hands.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child (26 TAC §746.3415(4))

occurrences.finding: Diapering Procedures - Sanitizing Diaper Changing Area: At the time of inspection the changing table was not disinfected after a diaper change.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diapering Procedures - Sanitizing Diaper Changing Area (26 TAC §746.3505(e))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional: At the time of inspection three infant feeding schedules were not available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional (26 TAC §746.2421(a))

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Drills: At the time of inspection, there was not any documentation for the fire drill being conducted this month.  This was corrected when the documentation was correctly added.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Drills (26 TAC §746.5205(4))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Using Inappropriate Long Period of Silence or Inactivity Including Requiring Child to Remain in a Restrictive Device: Two children older than 18 months were placed in the high chairs.  This was corrected when the children were removed from the high chairs.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Using Inappropriate Long Period of Silence or Inactivity Including Requiring Child to Remain in a Restrictive Device (26 TAC §746.2805(10))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children: One infant was in the infant room unsupervised.  This was corrected when the caregiver and the rest of the children entered the infant room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))

occurrences.finding: Furnishings and Equipment for Toddlers - Age-appropriate: At the time of inspection there were not any age appropriate toys in the classroom the children were combined in.  The toys were only infant toys.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Furnishings and Equipment for Toddlers - Age-appropriate (26 TAC §746.2505(1))

occurrences.finding: Diapering Procedures - Sanitizing Diaper Changing Area: At the time of inspection the diaper changing mat was not sanitized.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diapering Procedures - Sanitizing Diaper Changing Area (26 TAC §746.3505(e))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: The annual fire inspection was expired.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering: The caregiver did not wash the child's hands after a diaper change.  This was corrected when the child's hands were washed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering (26 TAC §746.3417(3))

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 12 or Fewer Children: During inspection, there were seven children in care with one caregiver. There were two infants under eighteen months combined with five children between the ages of eighteen months and four years. According to minimum standards, there can only be four children or less age eighteen months to four years combined with two infants under eighteen months if there is only one caregiver present.     This was corrected at inspection when another caregiver arrived and the operation was brought into ratio compliance.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 12 or Fewer Children (26 TAC §746.1701)

occurrences.finding: Diapering Procedures - Wash Infant's Hands: A caregiver failed to wash one infant's hands after diaper changing.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diapering Procedures - Wash Infant's Hands (26 TAC §746.3505(b))
